verdict.rationale: The first-party multi-agent docs describe running multiple isolated agents in one Gateway, each with its own workspace, agentDir, auth, and session history. They also document multi-agent routing via channel accounts and bindings, so conversations and channels can be sent to specific agents. A community user independently reports running 9 agents on one machine with a distinct persona for each. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each agent can be pinned to its own model, first-party detail on per-agent system prompts, and depth on how binding and routing rules are configured.
